'''Jury Service, Summons, and Hardship Continuity'''是 Human Infra 在“局部阻塞解除”控制轴下维护的独立研究域。该词条同步项目研究材料，并将其放入主体持续性和可能性空间框架审查。

== 对 Human Infra 的作用 ==
未命中更高层边界、载体、能力、转换或生态规则，暂归为具体场景的局部可能性解锁。

== 机制或依赖 ==

<pre>
研究域对象
  -> 影响变量或中间机制
  -> 改变主体状态、外部条件或路径可达性
  -> 改变风险、能力、时间成本或资源约束
  -> 改变有效寿命、有效时间或未来选择权
</pre>

本域位于 C6“局部可能性解锁层”。其具体上下游依赖以项目分类表和下列域研究材料为准。

== 证据与来源 ==

本页面的分类、对象与研究边界来自 Human Infra 仓库的受治理域 README；README 是研究组织资料，不自动构成科学、医学、法律或工程事实证据。正文中的外部主张必须继续绑定论文原文、官方标准、监管文件、数据库或权威报告。

== 域研究材料 ==

This domain studies jury service as a civic obligation and access system: summons delivery, qualification, exemptions, hardship requests, employer protections, accessibility, language, childcare, transportation, and nonresponse consequences.

Human Infra value: jury service can protect civic participation and legal legitimacy, but it can also disrupt work, care, health, income, transportation, and safety if participation pathways and hardship safeguards are not understandable or accessible.

<span id="scope"></span>
== Scope ==

* Jury summons delivery and response
* Qualification, exemption, deferral, and hardship categories at system level
* Employer, wage, childcare, transportation, disability, language, and safety barriers
* Juror privacy and data minimization
* Nonresponse and failure-to-appear consequences as policy issues
* Public trust, representativeness, and civic participation

<span id="non-goals"></span>
== Non-Goals ==

* No advice on whether or how to respond to a summons, request deferral, claim exemption, avoid service, or answer voir dire.
* No legal advice, employment advice, medical advice, disability documentation advice, or strategy for selection or nonselection.
* No juror targeting, manipulation, intimidation, identity exposure, or court evasion.

<span id="source-spine"></span>
== Source Spine ==

* U.S. Courts jury service public materials.
* National Center for State Courts jury service and court management materials.
* State jury portals as implementation examples.
* ADA.gov and language access resources for participation barriers.

* 若缺少来源、适用对象、证据等级或反证条件，应把相关主张视为待核验，而不是事实。
* 域的存在不等于技术可行、干预有效、风险可接受或主体连续性得到证明。
